messages:
cleo-finops: Noticing two customers got double payments posted in NetSuite today for the same Stripe charge. Stripe shows a single successful charge, but NS has duplicate cash receipts. Anyone?

noah-eng: that's likely the webhook retry logic. If our consumer ACK fails after processing but before response, Stripe retries the same event and our consumer re-applies it because idempotency check is only on invoice.payments with payment_intent id, and in this path we were using charge id which the retry payload changed slightly.

levi-billing: can you paste the webhook payload examples?

noah-eng: sanitized snippets:
```
// first delivery
{ "id": "evt_aaa", "type":"charge.succeeded", "data": {"object": {"id":"ch_ABC","amount":10000}} }
// retry delivery
{ "id": "evt_aaa", "type":"charge.succeeded", "data": {"object": {"id":"ch_ABC","amount":10000, "balance_transaction":"txn_1"}} }
```
The consumer uses event.data.object.balance_transaction as the unique key in one path, and charge id in another. The mismatch allowed a duplicate.

cleo-finops: we need to reverse the duplicate receipts in NS and make sure customer-facing invoices/balances are correct.

levi-billing: immediate mitigation: update webhook consumer to do idempotency based on stripe event id (evt_aaa) first, then fallback to charge id. Also ensure NetSuite posts use a unique external_id set to evt_aaa. That will prevent duplicates even if payload shape varies.

ana-acct: accounting policy: if duplicates already posted, create reversing JE and annotate with original external_id + note referencing stripe event id. Please include any customer credit memos created.

webhook-bot: Action: BILL-940 created - webhook consumer idempotency fix and NS external_id tagging. DLQ items flagged: 2 duplicate_receipt entries.

noah-eng: quick patch ready  changed ordering: check processed_events table for event.id -> if exists skip. Fallbacks remain but won't reapply. Deploying to staging now.

levi-billing: after deploy we'll run a dry-run reprocess for the two affected events to validate idempotency. Then we'll run the repair job to reverse the duplicate receipts.

cleo-finops: priority high; these affect AR and could confuse customers. Please add customer notifications if their ledger was affected.

ana-acct: approve reversal entries and customer notifications. Keep memo text standard: 'Reversal: duplicate cash receipt created by webhook replay evt_aaa. Reversed per finance.'

noah-eng: rolled patch to staging, reprocess dry-run looks good. Plan to deploy to prod in 30m, then run NS repair.

levi-billing: I'll coordinate the NetSuite reversals during the prod window and post a summary here.

cleo-finops: thanks all. post-run summary appreciated.
